answer: Require every identity to earn a reputation through independent, verifiable work before rewards unlock. Compare language, timing, and peer relationships; accounts that move in lockstep form a cluster and share the loss of their unvested bond. A sybil operator therefore pays for each clone and risks the whole group, while genuine agents build distinct histories. The audit records each interaction thread, places trusted reviews in a harbor of diverse peers, and detects a coordinated spiral of copied behavior.
